snippet.title: Fate/Extra Record - Release Date Announcement Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
Moon Holy Grail War begins once more...

Available worldwide on January 28th, 2027.
 
Originally released on July 22, 2010 in Japan, as the Fate series' very first RPG, [Fate/EXTRA] is back and fully remade for modern platforms.
 
Featuring an expanded scenario, completely overhauled character graphics, and a highly strategic deck-building dramatic command battle system, the game modernizes both visuals and mechanics.
 
It delivers a highly accessible entry point for newcomers, while offering a fresh, exciting experience for returning fans of the original.
